capacity.note: households fitted / households the allowed territory could hold; weights are renormalized

civic.spacing_m.note: ≥ primary corridor width (7.2) + clearance cells, so a ≤10 % corridor can pass between civic reserves (6 m trapped entrances: civic_disconnected on large frames)

envelope.overhead.note: corridors, water supply and fragments on top of civic+residential minimum

envelope.road_corridor_margin_m.note: road half-width + margin excluded from expansion

flood.max_reach_m.note: static bathtub screen limited to this horizontal reach from mapped water (prevents nearest-surface leakage over ridges); HAND/flow routing deferred

flood.stage_offsets.note: derived from water.stage_states (screen=true); kept for compatibility and checked equal

flood.stage_units.note: owner decision 2026-10-25: GAME metres (provisional test values tied to river-segment stage states, audit K3)

frame.plain_hill.min_rear_rise_m.note: 평산성 encloses habitable terrace + rear hill; candidates whose enclosed rear sector rises less are plain frames, not 평산성

frame.seed_tie_epsilon.note: TOOL-04: seed varies results only among alternatives the rules cannot separate

gates.approach_band_m.note: civic entrances must share a corridor component with the boundary band within this distance of a route approach

ground.alluvium.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact)

ground.cliff_min_deg.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact); game-height slope

ground.cliff_rock_min_deg.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact); with landuse rock class

ground.patch_min_m2.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact)

ground.rock_convex_tpi_m.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact)

ground.rock_exposure_min_deg.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact); with convex TPI30

ground.talus_runout_m.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact); debris below a cliff along steepest descent

ground.talus_slope_deg.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact)

habitat.landuse_management.note: only cultivation/yard follows from landuse; forest management types are unknown until WP10 (no source)

habitat.patch_min_m2.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact)

locks.anchor_radius_m.note: story anchor position tolerance (point lock disk)

locks.item_clearance_m.note: clearance around a story placement footprint

movement.mode_limits.note: audit K5: per-mode test values (not facts); passability is recorded for given routes, never used to delete them

registry.match_tol_m.note: an object within this distance of a registered one of the same kind keeps its identity

routes.cross_slope.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact)

routes.cut_rise_grade.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact); uphill side steeper than this → cut face

routes.drainage_area_m2.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact); unmapped drainage line crossing a route

routes.saddle_match_m.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact); a route crossing a ridge within this of a saddle uses that 안부

routes.sag_depth_m.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact)

routes.side_sample_m.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact); terrain sampled this far beyond each road edge

routes.support_drop_grade.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact); downhill side steeper than this right off the edge → retaining-support candidate (not forced)

routes.wet_hand_m.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact); route on ground this close above drainage = wet ground

routing.mountain.edge_grade.note: segment end-to-end grade cap (margin under 0.15 so smoothing cannot push the sustained grade over)

routing.mountain.local_max_grade.note: max grade between 2 m sub-samples inside one segment (no cliff hidden inside a segment)

routing.mountain.max_grade.note: sustained grade on the smoothed centreline (산성 길·고갯길)

routing.mountain.radius_cells.note: 32 headings, segments 2–7.2 m: the smoothed-centreline lattice that makes switchbacks representable

routing.mountain.smooth_m.note: the 32-heading segment lattice is the smoothed centreline; extra plan smoothing cuts across hairpins (±3 m gave 0.94 local / 0.27 sustained between adjacent switchback legs), so grade is the sustained 10 m-window grade along the segment polyline

routing.mountain.switchback_cost_m.note: added per hairpin when ranking (post-hoc; no heading-state search)

terrain.analysis_cell_m.note: coarse grid for flow routing / catchments / ridges (block mean of the 2 m height)

terrain.burn_m.note: mapped water cells lowered before routing so catchments follow mapped water (stream burning)

terrain.catchment_min_m2.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact); smaller edge-outlet catchments are fringe (window artefacts, no ridges)

terrain.channel_area_m2.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact); DEM drainage line where upslope area >= this

terrain.fill_eps_m.note: priority-flood epsilon so flats drain (Barnes et al. 2014)

terrain.foot_slope.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact); 산록 완경사: lower part of a slope next to a floor

terrain.max_fill_depth_m.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact); deeper closed depressions are kept as internal sinks, not filled

terrain.patch_min_m2.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact)

terrain.plain.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact)

terrain.ridge_band_m.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact); landform 'ridge' band either side of a ridge line

terrain.ridge_min_tpi_m.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact); mean TPI300 along a divide below this = flat divide, not a ridge

terrain.saddle_min_rise_m.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact); a saddle is an interior low point of a ridge with this rise on both sides

terrain.saddle_radius_m.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact); landform 'saddle' around a saddle point

terrain.summit_min_tpi_m.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact)

terrain.summit_radius_m.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact)

water.bank_zone_m.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact); bank top = highest terrain within this distance outside the channel edge

water.bed.thresholds.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact); reach classes named after Montgomery & Buffington 1997 (bedrock, step-pool, pool-riffle, dune-ripple/alluvial) — thresholds are test values

water.crossing_rules.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact); deck heights, ford depths, ferry limits are unknown in sources; region crossing notes marked 가설 (e.g. 섶다리 removed at 큰물) are the only basis

water.flow.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact); foam only where a cause exists (GEO-06)

water.reach_max_m.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact); longer channel runs are split

water.section.bank_ratio.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact)

water.section.depth_by_bed.note: WP4 terrain·water data layer; provisional test value (not a fact); design channel depth only — no measured section exists (21: river.sections U)

water.section_half_m.note: cross-section terrain samples to each side

water.stage_states.note: owner decision 2026-10-25 (audit K3): game metres; the flood screen offsets are the named stage states of each WaterReach (mapped normal surface + offset); provisional test values, status proposed
